    input = sys.stdin.read().splitlines()
    index = 0
    t = int(input[index])
    index += 1
    results = []
    for _ in range(t):
        n = int(input[index])
        s = input[index + 1]
        index += 2
        min_length = -1
        prefix_counts = defaultdict(int)
        prefix_counts[(0, 0)] = -1
        a_count = b_count = c_count = 0
        for i, char in enumerate(s):
            if char == 'a':
                a_count += 1
            elif char == 'b':
                b_count += 1
            else:
                c_count += 1
            diff_ab = a_count - b_count
            diff_ac = a_count - c_count
            if (diff_ab - 1, diff_ac) in prefix_counts:
                length = i - prefix_counts[(diff_ab - 1, diff_ac)]
                if min_length == -1 or length < min_length:
                    min_length = length
            if (diff_ab, diff_ac - 1) in prefix_counts:
                length = i - prefix_counts[(diff_ab, diff_ac - 1)]
                if min_length == -1 or length < min_length:
                    if length >= 2:
                        min_length = length
            if (diff_ab - 1, diff_ac - 1) in prefix_counts:
                length = i + 1 - prefix_counts[(diff_ab - 1, diff_ac - 1)]
                if min_length == -1 or (length >= 2 and length < min_length):
                    min_length = length
            if (diff_ab, diff_ac) not in prefix_counts:
                prefix_counts[(diff_ab, diff_ac)] = i
        results.append(min_length)
    print('\n'.join(map(str, results)))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
